title: CytoLex — band exceptions (curated/bands/<version>/exceptions.yaml)
description: Every difference between the book's idiograms (kb/bands/<version>/ideograms.yaml) and the NCBI band sets, per level, decided and cited (T-007). `kb bands` fails on a difference without an entry and on an entry that no longer matches a difference.

band.x-expected: a band name such as 9q34.1 (no ranges, no arm-level terms)

level.description: Band level compared (the NCBI sets exist for 400, 550 and 850).

region.description: The shortest name of the group: every name in `book` and `ncbi` is it or one of its sub-bands.

book.description: Names the book shows at this level and NCBI doesn't (ranges expanded).

ncbi.description: Names NCBI has at this level and the book doesn't.

resolution.description: book: the level follows the book (book names gain it, NCBI-only names lose it). ncbi: the NCBI level is kept.

keep.description: With resolution book: NCBI-only names that no book level covers and that stay valid anyway, flagged `book: false` in bands.yaml with their NCBI levels.
